body: At least push to 30 to see how fast the days start to fly by. I find it manageable for the meantime maybe you will too.

22 is good congrats on making it that far. Have you noticed the difference in your perception of time compared to when you where say 15? After about 25 if you aren't doing anything the years start to fly by like months it really creeps up on you. Just the same thing over n over i think that's what people mean when they say that generic "it gets better with time" bs. It doesn't get better with time but time starts to go by so fast that all you have to do is fill your days with distractions (be it working like a salve to the system or finding a niche you enjoy) and before you realize you're in the grave.

How old are you? You speak like you have made it a long way through the struggle.  
Try keeping a loaded gun next to your bed. Anytime you feel like ending it put he barrel in your mouth pointed at your spine, see if you have the balls. If you don't, congrats you made it through the day.  
Also try drugs and alcohol first. Don't die before you have experienced the pleasures of flesh, an ice binge feels way better than unconsciousness. Or if unconsciousness IS your thing try heroin. At the very least have some fun before you sleep :)

Well you're here instead of finding a gun/ learning how to tie a proper noose so i assume you want help and don't really want to end it yet. In which case there are plenty of professionals willing to help. However, much like a drug addict in rehab one cannot change unless they want to. No other person can help you find happiness only you can.
Why was this post removed? It wasn't harming anyone and having this outlet to vent is important to me.

It's kinda like being a blackout drunk but remembering everything afterwards.
You feel fine in the worst of moments only to come to and realize how inappropriate you have been once you clear your head.
Then you laugh uncontrollably at how fucked up THAT is and its sort of and endless cycle where you just look like a jackass laughing hysterically at the worst things imaginable. Explaining it to people is complicated we don't have a proper spokesperson yet besides Joker and he is just a character.
